If you bought the wrong thing, press R to undo this purchase. You cannot undo after leaving the shop.
Player Info

The battle UI has three layers: top-left shows your HP, buffs and Gold; top-center shows the enemies and their intent for the next turn.

Below that are the item slots, the play area and your hand; bottom-left holds the card piles and the redraw button, bottom-right is the Act button.
Player Item Slots
These are your item slots. When the arrows in the play area match an item recipe, that item triggers in order. Longer recipes are checked first.
Enemy Info

This is the enemy. The icon and number above it show its intent for the next turn.

If there are multiple enemies, click one to focus it. Items target the leftmost enemy by default.
Basic Arrows

Arrows only have four directions: Up, Down, Left and Right.

Each direction triggers its own base effect when read: Fire (Up) deals damage, Water (Down) applies a debuff, Wind (Left) draws you an extra card next turn, Earth (Right) gives you Shield.
Trigger Items

Arrows in the play area are read from left to right. Whenever a position matches an item recipe, that item triggers automatically.

One start position can trigger several items; longer recipes are checked first.
Play Arrows

Click an arrow in your hand to select it, then click the upper area to play it; you can also drag arrows to reorder them.

After placing arrows in the play area, click the Act button at the lower right to end the turn.
Cancel Play

If an arrow is placed incorrectly, click it in the play area to return it to your hand (this refunds your play limit).

Place one arrow first, then click it back.
Play Limit

The number between the play area and the item slots shows [played this turn / play limit].

Placing an arrow spends limit; clicking it back to your hand refunds it. When the limit is used up you cannot play more arrows this turn (arrows with exemptions are not limited).
Redraw

When you draw arrows you do not want, select them and click the redraw button at the lower left to draw again.

Your redraw count resets to 1 at the start of your turn. Some effects can increase it temporarily or permanently.

Now, try redrawing your whole hand.
Claim Rewards
Winning a battle grants its gold automatically; then pick one of three rewards (you can also skip).
Undo Reward
If you make a mistaken choice, press R to undo this reward claim.
Shop Purchases

In shops you can buy items and arrows, or remove extra arrows.

A purchased item goes straight into your item bar, no slot picking; arrows and removals also apply on click.
Item Order

You can drag items in the item bar to reorder them.

The order decides the trigger order: one position can trigger several items in a row, and longer recipes are checked first.
Undo Purchase

If you bought the wrong thing, press R to undo this purchase.

Note: once you leave the shop it can no longer be undone.
Event Options

Each event has multiple options. Play the matching arrow combination to choose an option.

Most requirements are random; if your hand cannot match any option, ending the turn without playing is how you leave.
Event Redraw

Each event has its own draw count.

You can still redraw in an event - whether and how many to redraw is up to you.
Rest

A rest node offers two options: recover health, or enchant one arrow.

Enchanting uses one draw to pick the target arrow.
Map Panel

The final goal is to defeat the Boss. Use the map to plan your route.

At first, only the Boss tile is revealed. You can only reveal information for adjacent tiles.
Map Movement

Play Up, Down, Left, and Right arrows to move to adjacent map tiles.

If the tile you reach is not empty, it triggers that content.
Step Limit
When your cleared level count reaches the limit, all tiles become Boss tiles and force a Boss battle. Prepare before that happens.
